note: Per-district rules for the Paddle App, keyed by depot key (the district's manifest name without the season, e.g. callowhillb). Anything left out takes the value in defaults. allowsShortRuns: a day may hold one regular run plus ONE additional short run (never a short run alone, never two short runs). shortRunMaxPayHours: a run is short when its paddle pay hours are BELOW this number.
